controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-20T00:00:00.000Z"
| STATS total_events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip
| SORT total_events DESC
| LIMIT 20
